surface.description: Where the event came from. The local web app, desktop and the server never send events (ADR-024, ADR-090).

app_version.description: The x.y.z version of the build that sent the event.

locale.description: The interface language when the event was sent.

$pageview.description: A landing page was viewed. Sent by posthog-js in cookieless mode; UTM tags and referrer are PostHog's own $ properties. No custom properties.

landing_cta_clicked.description: A call to action on the landing page was clicked.

app_first_opened.description: Sent once per install, right after the first opt-in. Nothing is sent before a person opts in, so earlier opens are never counted.

portal_opened.description: The hosted portal was opened by a signed-in person who has turned on anonymous usage.

analytics_opted_in.description: A person turned on anonymous usage. A new random ID is created first, so this is the first event under it.

prompt.description: Turned on from the one-time prompt or from Settings.

analytics_opted_out.description: A person turned anonymous usage off. This is the last event under the random ID: it is sent once, then sending stops and the ID is deleted (MUT-153 D5).

client_created.description: A client was saved on the phone. Fires on the local save, so offline entries count when they are made.

income_recorded.description: An income entry was saved on the phone. Fires on the local save.

currency.description: The entry's currency code. Never the amount.

paid.description: Whether it was saved as already paid.

expense_recorded.description: An expense was saved on the phone. Fires on the local save.

currency.description: The expense's currency code. Never the amount.

payment_recorded.description: A payment received was saved on the phone. Fires on the local save.

currency.description: The payment's currency code. Never the amount.
